desc_zh: 按项目尺寸和画面文件生产 PVC 广告横幅，可选多种边缘与安装加工方式。
desc_en: Custom-printed PVC banners produced to your project dimensions, with a choice of practical finishing options.

detail_zh.lead: 定制 PVC 横幅喷绘成品：门头招牌、开业条幅、活动宣传与户外广告最常用的画面材料。按成品尺寸和画面文件生产，340 / 440 / 510 三档克重可选，另有 frontlit 与 blockout 两种结构，后道加工按实际安装方式选择。
highlights: 340 / 440 / 510 三档克重可选，越重越挺括、越抗风
frontlit 与 blockout 两种结构可选；blockout 不透光，适合双面画面
根据项目需求定制成品尺寸
支持包边、打鸡眼扣、加绳及穿杆袋
可按指定成品尺寸裁切
applications: 围挡、工地及临时宣传展示
delivery: 西安同城（以确认下单制作时间为准）：11:00 前下单当天下午送达，19:00 前次日中午前送达，19:00 后次日下午送达
三环内必达，三环外多数郊区可达；自有封闭式面包车专送，整卷送货上门
江浙沪皖由浙江嘉兴海盐合作工厂发货；其他地区时效按订单确认
卷装交付，成品按尺寸裁切；包装形式按订单确认
detail_zh.artwork: 客户可以提供印刷文件。基础文件检查和简单调整可免费提供；较大幅度修改或从零设计需单独报价。
detail_zh.brief: 请提供成品宽度和高度、数量、设计文件、加工位置（如有指定鸡眼间距请注明）、交付形式及目的地。
detail_zh.caveat: 克重与结构请按使用场景确认：短期活动和长期户外的选法不同，拿不准时把安装位置和展示时长发来，我们按场景建议。成品尺寸、克重与价格按订单确认，不预设标价。需要发票可代开，确认订单时说明即可。

detail_en.lead: Made-to-order printed PVC banners for shopfront signs, opening banners, outdoor advertising, events and promotions. Produced to your finished dimensions from your artwork, in a choice of 340, 440 or 510 gsm weights and frontlit or blockout constructions, with finishing matched to the way the banner will be installed.
highlights: Three weights — 340, 440 and 510 gsm; heavier weights hang flatter and handle wind better
Frontlit and blockout constructions; blockout is opaque, for double-sided graphics
Custom dimensions based on your project brief
Hemming, eyelets, rope finishing and pole pockets available
Cut to the requested finished size
applications: Fencing, site and temporary campaign displays
delivery: Production and dispatch timing confirmed per order
Sea freight to Australian main ports is around 40 days as a reference
Photos of the finished banners and the export packing are sent for your confirmation before dispatch
Rolled packing; banners are trimmed to the finished size before rolling
detail_en.artwork: Print-ready artwork can be supplied by the buyer. Basic file checks and minor adjustments are available at no extra cost; extensive artwork changes or original design work are quoted separately.
detail_en.brief: Please share finished width and height, quantity, artwork, finishing positions (including eyelet spacing if specified), delivery format and destination.
detail_en.caveat: Weight and construction are confirmed against the application: short-term event use and long-term outdoor exposure call for different choices, so share the installation position and display period and we will recommend accordingly. Finished dimensions, weight and pricing are confirmed per order; no list prices are published.

seo_title_en: Custom PVC Banner Printing | Trade Supply & Finishing | YINZAOSUO
seo_description_zh: PVC横幅喷绘定制：340、440、510 克重可选，包边、扣眼、加绳、穿杆套等后道按安装方式加工，适用于门头招牌、工地围挡与活动现场。面向广告公司批量制作，尺寸与价格按询价确认。
seo_description_en: Custom printed PVC banners for trade projects, with made-to-order dimensions, hemming, eyelets, rope finishing and pole pockets.
